feature: Marketing Manager Audit - selfrules.org Growth Strategy
workflow_rationale: This is a pure research and analysis task producing strategic documentation. The investigation workflow fits: discover current state, analyze gaps, synthesize findings, produce actionable recommendations. No code changes involved.

phases.name: Current State Analysis
phases.description: Analyze selfrules.org positioning, customer journey, growth loops, and AARRR funnel to establish baseline

subtasks.description: Analyze website positioning and messaging hierarchy

verification.instructions: Verify MARKETING_AUDIT_REPORT.md contains Positioning Analysis section with: headline analysis, value proposition hierarchy, CTA effectiveness scores, tone consistency assessment

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 2. Positioning score: 8.4/10. Key finding: 'Translator' positioning is unique and defensible.

subtasks.description: Map current customer journey touchpoints across all 5 stages (Awareness to Advocacy)

verification.instructions: Verify report contains Customer Journey Mapping section with all 5 stages scored, touchpoint inventory, and gap severity assessment

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 2. Critical gaps: Awareness 4/10, Retention 2/10, Advocacy 2/10.

subtasks.description: Audit current growth loops (Viral/UGC, Content/SEO, Paid, Sales/Referral) and AARRR funnel metrics

verification.instructions: Verify report contains Growth Loop Assessment table with all 4 loop types and AARRR funnel analysis with scores per stage

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 3. Primary recommendation: Content/SEO + Sales/Referral dual engine. Funnel leakage ~99.5%.

phases.name: Competitive Benchmarking
phases.description: Analyze direct competitors (PM consultants, platforms) and indirect competitors (training, full-time hires)

subtasks.description: Analyze direct competitors: Toptal, Product People Europe, freelancer platforms, individual PM coaches

verification.instructions: Verify report contains competitive landscape map, positioning matrix with 10+ competitors, pricing comparison, content strategy comparison

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 3. Key finding: 'Translator' category unclaimed. Italian market has no Ken Norton equivalent.

subtasks.description: Analyze indirect competitors: full-time PM hires, training programs, internal promotion, DIY learning

verification.instructions: Verify report contains indirect competitor analysis, JTBD mapping, price anchoring framework, battle card positioning

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 3. Key finding: Sessions = 98% savings vs. full-time hire. 3 primary JTBD identified.

phases.name: SWOT Analysis
phases.description: Synthesize Phase 1-2 findings into comprehensive SWOT analysis with cross-analysis and strategic priorities

subtasks.description: Create SWOT analysis with 3-5 items per quadrant, cross-analysis (S-O, W-O, S-T, W-T), and top 5 strategic priorities

verification.instructions: Verify SWOT has 5 items per quadrant, all grounded in website analysis. Cross-analysis covers all 4 strategy types. Top 5 priorities listed with SWOT references.

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 3. Positioning 9/10, Growth Infrastructure 2/10. Strategic imperative: preserve positioning, urgently build growth systems.

phases.name: Strategy Development
phases.description: Develop optimized positioning statement, 90-day growth strategy, and channel prioritization

subtasks.description: Create optimized positioning statement in standard format (Target, Need, Category, Differentiator, Proof) with Italian version and short-form variants

verification.instructions: Verify positioning statement follows 'For [target] who [need], [name] is the [category] that [differentiator] because [proof]' format with all 5 elements present

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 4. New category created: 'Product Management Translator'. Short-form variants for LinkedIn, Twitter, elevator pitches.

subtasks.description: Develop 90-day growth strategy with 3 phases: Quick Wins (Wk 1-4), Strategic (Wk 5-8), Transformational (Wk 9-12)

verification.instructions: Verify strategy includes weekly action plans, success metrics per phase, investment requirements, risk mitigation plan

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 4. Targets: 400 subscribers, 5K monthly visitors, 15 calls/month by Day 90. Investment: 40-55 hrs/month, EUR 150-600 total.

subtasks.description: Score and prioritize marketing channels using Reach x (10 - Cost) x Control / 100 formula

verification.instructions: Verify all channels scored with formula, ranked table created, resource allocation recommendations included

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 4. Top 3: Email (4.20), LinkedIn (3.78), Blog/SEO (3.60). Paid ads not recommended (0.54).

phases.name: Campaign Design
phases.description: Design 5 high-impact campaigns targeting 10x traffic and lead growth, each with Objective, Audience, Channels, Tactics, KPIs, Timeline

subtasks.description: Design Campaign 1: 'The Translation Fails' Content/SEO Growth Loop - sustainable organic traffic engine

verification.instructions: Verify campaign brief has all 6 required elements: Objective, Target Audience, Channels, Tactics, KPIs, Timeline. Content calendar with 15 articles included.

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 4. Target: 5,000 monthly visitors by Day 90 (100x increase). 4 content pillars defined.

subtasks.description: Design Campaign 2: 'PM Translation Toolkit' Lead Magnet Email Capture - build owned email list from zero

verification.instructions: Verify campaign brief has all 6 elements. Lead magnet contents described. 6-email nurture sequence documented. Technical setup requirements listed.

subtasks.notes: Completed in Session 4. Toolkit: 5 templates + case study. Target: 400 subscribers by Day 90. 6-email nurture sequence over 14 days.

subtasks.description: Design Campaign 3: Referral/Advocacy Program - systematize word-of-mouth and client referrals with NPS collection, referral incentives, testimonial request automation

verification.instructions: Verify campaign brief has all 6 elements (Objective, Target Audience, Channels, Tactics, KPIs, Timeline). Referral incentive structure defined. Post-session NPS flow documented. Advocacy program mechanics detailed.

subtasks.notes: Completed. Campaign 3 'The Translation Network' Referral & Advocacy Program designed with all 6 elements: (1) Objective - systematize referrals with 3+ calls/month target, 80% NPS response rate, 20%+ revenue from referrals; (2) Target Audience - 3 personas (Satisfied Client, Recurring Client, Referred Lead); (3) Channels - Email automation, WhatsApp, referral links, LinkedIn, case studies; (4) Tactics - 6 tactics: NPS automation flow, referral request + incentive structure (30-min free call), testimonial request pipeline, 3-tier advocacy program (Translator/Ambassador/Inner Circle), re-engagement sequence, social proof library; (5) KPIs - NPS metrics, referral metrics, testimonial metrics, advocacy tier tracking with leading/lagging indicators; (6) Timeline - Week 5-12 rollout (Foundation → Activation → Scale). Lowest-cost campaign (€0-20/mo), highest ROI due to 4-5x conversion rate on referred leads.

subtasks.description: Design Campaign 4: LinkedIn Thought Leadership - establish 'Product Management Translator' category ownership through profile optimization, content strategy, engagement tactics

verification.instructions: Verify campaign brief has all 6 elements. LinkedIn posting strategy with content types and frequency. Profile optimization checklist. Engagement strategy documented. Connection growth tactics.

subtasks.notes: LinkedIn scored 3.78 (2nd highest channel). Should include profile optimization, content calendar, posting templates, engagement strategy, connection growth, LinkedIn newsletter consideration.

subtasks.description: Design Campaign 5: Podcast/Speaking Guest Strategy - expand reach through earned media with target podcast list, pitch templates, guest one-sheet, post-appearance conversion funnel

verification.instructions: Verify campaign brief has all 6 elements. Target podcast list (Italian + English). Guest one-sheet template. Pitch email templates. Post-appearance conversion funnel documented.

subtasks.notes: Podcast Guesting scored 1.68 (opportunistic channel). Should include target podcast list, pitch templates, one-sheet, speaking topic menu, post-appearance conversion funnel, measurement strategy.

phases.name: Final Report Compilation
phases.description: Compile Executive Summary, verify all sections complete, ensure format compliance and deliverable quality

subtasks.description: Compile final Marketing Audit Report: write Executive Summary, verify all sections complete, ensure marketing-manager skill format compliance, add implementation checklist, cross-reference all deliverables

verification.instructions: QA checklist: (1) Executive Summary written with 2-3 sentence overview, (2) All 4 deliverables complete (SWOT, Positioning, Strategy, 5 Campaigns), (3) All frameworks applied (AARRR, Growth Loops, Journey, Channel Scoring), (4) 10x growth target addressed with realistic pathways, (5) All 5 campaigns have 6 required elements each, (6) Recommendations specific to selfrules.org context, (7) Italian market primary consideration, (8) Output follows marketing-manager skill format, (9) No generic/templated content, (10) Implementation checklist present

subtasks.notes: Final compilation. Executive Summary still marked 'To be completed'. All preceding sections must be verified for completeness and consistency.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: N/A - sequential analysis workflow requiring cumulative context

Customer journey mapped across all 5 stages
Growth loops assessed with primary loop recommendation
All deliverables follow marketing-manager skill output format
Recommendations are specific to selfrules.org context
10x growth target addressed with realistic pathways

verification_steps.name: Deliverable Completeness Check
verification_steps.expected_outcome: All 4 core deliverables (SWOT, Positioning, Strategy, 5 Campaigns) present and complete

verification_steps.name: Framework Application Check
verification_steps.expected_outcome: AARRR, Growth Loops, Customer Journey, and Channel Scoring frameworks properly applied

verification_steps.name: Content Quality Check
verification_steps.expected_outcome: All recommendations reference actual website content, are actionable, measurable, feasible for solo consultant, and brand-aligned

verification_strategy.reasoning: No code changes - documentation only. Validation focuses on deliverable completeness and quality rather than automated testing.
